policy.action_definition: For each current name with host feature vector x, rank the full list by x^T*A_inv*b+alpha*sqrt(x^T*A_inv*x). A_inv is the inverse accumulated feature matrix and b the accumulated credit vector; both update on all current actions.
policy.counter_definition: The native reward agent computes reward_function.evaluate(metric, last_prioritization) and adds each rank-aligned credit to that current name's cumulative ValueEstimates V. Missing joined credit adds zero. Every ranked name receives an ActionAttempts increment from numpy.linspace(1.0, 1e-12, ranking_length), so ActionAttempts N is fractional rank exposure, including unscheduled names, not selected-arm pulls. The agent increments t once per observe before policy credit_assignment; t is a logical observation count, not elapsed time or number of choose calls. The ordinary ContextualAgent has the cumulative V, rank-exposure N and logical t behavior just described. For every current action with feature column vector x, policy credit_assignment adds x*x^T to its matrix A, recomputes A_inv=inverse(A), and adds V*x to vector b. Each new/re-entering name starts with identity A and zero b. Because V is cumulative here, earlier native credit is added repeatedly. Feature dimensions/scales are supplied by the host, without a physical-unit or calibration contract. Ranking uses x^T*A_inv*b+alpha*sqrt(x^T*A_inv*x); all current actions receive regression updates, not only the first ranked or scheduled action.
policy.guidance: Preserve this explicitly native CI ranking recipe. Generic sampled choice, selected subsets, observed pairwise feedback, calibrated probabilities and independent recipe mixtures need their own qualified implementations; never infer them from this name.

lifecycle.checkpoint_definition: The 37-name mechanical dispatch fixture disabled native restore/checkpoints. No all-policy ordinary pickle or global-RNG recovery guarantee follows.
lifecycle.discovery: Current agent rows drop retired names and append sorted new names; contextual update_actions has its own context setup/re-entry path. No generic identity/version mapping is performed.
lifecycle.reset: Agent.reset zeros current ValueEstimates/ActionAttempts/Q, last ranking and t, but retains action names, policy object/state, agent RNG and caches; window history is not cleared. Environment reset is not fresh construction or RNG rewind.
lifecycle.retirement: Per-name context matrices A, their inverses A_inv and vectors b are retained when agent rows retire. On re-entry, add_action overwrites that name with identity A, inverse identity A_inv and zero b. Context features and feature-list lifetime remain host-owned.
lifecycle.sharing: Factory creates one policy object for each named policy/reward recipe; agent rows and policy RNG lifetime follow their explicit owners.

policy.theory_statement: Qualified source/synthetic mechanical evidence only; original sampled-action, pairwise, calibrated or independent-observation guarantees are not claimed. After every build update EVERY current arm A+=xx^T,b+=ValueEstimates*x. Under ContextualAgent ValueEstimates is cumulative native reward, so past reward is added repeatedly.

reward.coverage: Ranking-aligned native learning credit computed from the supplied budgeted metric. Zero for an unscheduled/uncredited position is not evidence of an executed passing test, full observed alternatives or a defined bounded loss. All actual metric/index assumptions remain native.
reward.formula: Per returned ranking position i, emit1 if i+1 is in metric.detection_ranks, otherwise0; when no detection ranks emit an all-zero vector. Rank indices are metric scheduled ranks, not newly observed outcomes.
